objective: Define and implement a meta-progression system to persist player unlocks, achievements, and optional progression data across runs.
prerequisites: Review Assets/docs/schemas/ for existing persistence schemas

steps.title: Design save schema
steps.description: Create Assets/docs/schemas/meta-progression.schema.json describing persisted fields and versioning.

steps.title: Implement data model
steps.description: Add C# POCOs under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/Meta/ matching schema and mark as [Serializable].

steps.title: Persistence API
steps.description: Implement MetaProgressionService with Load/Save/Reset/MigrateIfNeeded using Application.persistentDataPath.

steps.title: Versioning & Migration
steps.description: Add version field and migration registry; include unit tests for migrations.

steps.title: Integration points
steps.description: Hook Save() to achievements, shops and provide editor import/export tools.

steps.title: UI & UX
steps.description: Provide minimal UI to view/reset progression and confirm destructive actions.

steps.title: Tests & Validation
steps.description: Unit tests for serialization, migrations, and add build-time schema compliance checks.

notes: Prefer JSON file storage for portability and testability.
Keep schema and C# models in sync; consider a CI parity check.
Split optional in-run snapshot save into a follow-up task to limit scope.
